criteria.description: World navigation on two axes reaches the intended objects
First-person view supports looking around and interaction
Walls, partition and furniture are physically blocking
Distinct near-visible keys enter inventory once
Pickup requires proximity and unobstructed sight
Chest needs both keys and exit needs the chest badge
Win follows physically traversing the unlocked exit
Restart resets inventory, locks and escape state
Keys are color-distinguishable, near/far objects and solid boundaries are legible, and inventory/lock state can be read.
Move/look/interact/restart instructions, current objective and missing-key/badge feedback guide the full route.
Pickup, rejected interaction, chest opening, badge acquisition, door unlock and actual escape are visibly distinguishable.
Warm wood/metal room style and lighting are coherent and readable from multiple viewpoints; essential UI fits both viewports. Photorealism is not required.
Observed delivery duration gated by demonstrated main-loop gameplay

limitations: Proposed engine-agnostic browser method; no maintainer acceptance or calibrated live-game judge is claimed.
Data-only protocol, not an executable Harbor task, creator adapter or automated recorder.
Evidence structure/arithmetic does not establish observation truth or authentic provenance.
Visible 3D behavior is assessed, not source-level engine implementation, exact physics or measured FPS.
Remote URLs can change; model labels and sampled delivery times are observations, not backend attestations.
Non-blind evaluation, platform defaults, missing data and all interventions must be disclosed.
Costs are reported separately; 60/10/30 totals are not historical Tetris scores or proof of equal task difficulty.
